fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Two letters of recommendation (must be original in Chinese or English) * 2. Personal Statement 3. Major of Architecture applicants: shall be submitted documents of professional skills or knowledge or architecture works. * 4. 2 photos of passport standard * 5. Passport copy Applicants in mainland China are also required to provide a copy of the current valid visa page or residence permit page. * 6. Certificate of HSK * 7. Copy of high school graduation certificate, or original verification of expected graduation for applicants who are yet to graduate Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 8. Original or notarized copy of the full high school score report Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 9. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements General: 18 years of age or above, in good health with valid Non-Chinese passport, and an educational background of completed high school or above; Applicants from mainland China，Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan should meet the relevant regulations of the ministry of education. Copy of HSK certificate, score at least 180 on the HSK (level 5); (or printed HSK score webpage, original certificate to be checked at registration);transfer students majoring in Chinese language (junior year) should score above HSK6 grade 180; There not required for applicants who have received 12-year Chinese education in Malaysia and Singapore; Test report of the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA), for detailed subject requirements, please refer to " Catalog of Undergraduate Programs 2026 ".
